decision.section: Iterate - feature: Untitled UI kit for the design plugin
decision.title: Untitled UI is a token-only CSS kit; a look is a token set
decision.context: Screens built from copy-paste snippets looked plain, and brand guidelines could restyle components. The operator wants one complete kit and guidelines that carry only tokens.
decision.decision: kit/untitled-ui/kit.css holds every component using var(--token) only; tokens/*.css (warm, clean, bold, svenroth) decide the look; tokens-contract.md lists the tokens; examples are generated by build_kit_examples.py and checked by tests, including WCAG contrast.
decision.consequences: A project's visual guidelines supply tokens only; a component change is a kit.css change. Design docs route untitled-ui screens to the kit; other flavors keep the snippets. The kit has no chat UI and no charts.
decision.rationale: One CSS file whose values are all tokens keeps the look controllable and testable; contrast and solid colours are enforced by tests rather than by review.
decision.rejected: Per-flavor snippet copies (drift, no tests); transparent primary tints (uncontrolled colours); a chat layout in the kit (the Claude app is the chat).

changelog.bullet: Design: a complete token-only Untitled UI kit (components, layouts, four token sets, token contract, UX rules with sources, generated examples) with tests for tokens, WCAG contrast, solid colours and example freshness
Design docs and the visual guidelines template now compose untitled-ui screens from the kit and list the kit tokens instead of the old snippet variable blocks

behaviors.behavior: kit.css holds no colour or font-size literal; colours, fonts, radii and shadows come from tokens
every token the kit uses, and every token the contract names, is defined by each token set (warm, clean, bold, svenroth)
WCAG contrast: muted 7:1 on bg, surface, table-header, hover, primary-soft and border; text 4.5:1; border-strong and focus 3:1; status text on its background
colour tokens are solid hex (only the overlay may be rgba); base font >= 16px, small >= 14px, heading sizes do not shrink
build_kit_examples --check passes on the committed tree, fails on a changed or orphaned example, write mode rebuilds, a token set without a font entry is refused
fragments use only classes kit.css defines, the gallery or board shows every component class, and the kit covers every class of the old component snippets
the 12 built example pages load in a real browser at 375 and 1280 px with no page error, no console error, no horizontal overflow on the board, and every form control named
behaviors.evidence: F0.5 web surface run: node Playwright check over examples/*.html, 16 passed (surface_verification.json)

behaviors.behavior: the look and feel (shadows, readability of inactive text, completeness against the Untitled UI list) is acceptable
behaviors.reason: operator approved the rendered examples (screenshots kit-preview-v5/v6/v7) in the iterate conversation

finalize.reason: iterate: Untitled UI kit for the design plugin

event_extras.description: Untitled UI kit for the design plugin
event_extras.summary: The design phase now has a complete, accessible Untitled UI component kit where colours, fonts and shadows come only from a token set, so a brand guideline can change the look without touching components.
event_extras.spec_impact_justification: Design still produces clickable mockups as FR-01.04 states; the kit changes how untitled-ui screens are styled, not what the phase delivers.
